item.title: Ducks: Two Years in the Oil Sands
item.description:
An autobiographical graphic novel, in the style of Guy Delisle, about Beaton’s time working in Alberta’s oil sands to pay off student debt. This is a book about sexual harassment and misogyny. About women working in a men’s world.

This is a MUST read for all, especially men. Named after a disaster where hundreds of ducks died in toxic tailings ponds, “the book draws devastating parallels between environmental and human degradation”.
